text: I think you might be surprised by this recommendation, but hear me out. While the title suggests a non-vegetarian dish, the ingredients are mostly neutral, and the soy sauce is a nod to your fondness for soy-based products. The marinade's flavor profile, with garlic powder, ginger, and pepper, is also reminiscent of Asian-inspired dishes you seem to enjoy. Given your tendency to opt for lower-saturated-fat options, this recipe might be a good fit, and the preparation time is even faster than your usual 45 minutes.
